purpose: Teach: 子連れ/いかんせん/寒気/絶句/思いこん/ほど遠い/年老い/顔立ち

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが子連れのご家族をよく見守ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father really does watch over families with children carefully, doesn't he?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft pride in the noticing. Slight lift at the end—inviting agreement but not requiring it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、いかんせんお疲れみたいだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad seems pretty tired though.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Not complaining—observing. The tone of a child who notices what adults think they're hiding. Small pause before the word 'tired', like he's being careful not to worry her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今日は寒気がするから温かくしてね
lines.en: Sho, you'll catch a chill today if you're not careful—keep yourself warm, alright?
lines.style: Practical care wrapped in gentleness. A shift into mother-mode—still warm but with the quiet authority of someone looking after someone else. Not fussy, just clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが感動して絶句されてたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad actually got emotional earlier—he was speechless for a moment.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the delivery. He's reporting something he observed and understood was meaningful. A little pride that he saw it. No urgency, just steady certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがぼくを子供だと思いこんでらっしゃるかな
lines.en: Sho, do you think your father still sees you as a little child?
lines.style: Wry, slightly amused at herself for the question. Knowing. There's affection underneath—not mocking Ryosuke, but gently testing the thought aloud. Tone suggests she already knows the answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、宿題は完璧にはほど遠いけど頑張ったよ
lines.en: Mom, my homework isn't perfect, but I really tried my best on it.
lines.style: Earnest and a little defensive in that small-child way. Pride in effort, not outcome. Wants her to see the trying. Steady voice—not seeking excessive praise, just recognition.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんも年老いてこられたわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandfather has gotten so much older now, hasn't he?
lines.style: Reflective, a little tender. The words drift slightly—she's noticing time's passage. Not sad, exactly, but aware. The tone of someone making a quiet reckoning with something she's observed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに似た顔立ちって言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, someone told me I have a face like Dad's.
lines.style: Pleased, slightly shy about it. There's warmth in the report—a small pride in the resemblance, said without trying too hard. Light, close to her, the way he shares small good things.
